topics.title: Linear equations in two variables and standard form

concepts.learning_objective: Identify a linear equation in two variables and write it in the standard form ax + by + c = 0.
Express an everyday situation as a linear equation in two variables.

topics.title: Solutions of a linear equation in two variables

concepts.learning_objective: Check whether an ordered pair satisfies a linear equation and recognise that there are infinitely many solutions.
Find the axis-intercept points of a line and relate solutions to points on its graph.
Explain why the line ax + by + c = 0 passes through the origin exactly when c = 0.
Calculate the slope of a line as rise over run using two points on it.
Read the slope and y-intercept from y = mx + d after rewriting ax + by + c = 0.
Recognise horizontal lines as having zero slope and vertical lines as having undefined slope.

topics.title: Pair of linear equations in two variables

concepts.learning_objective: Frame a pair of linear equations in two variables from a word situation.
State that a solution of a pair is an ordered pair satisfying both equations.
Solve a pair of linear equations by expressing one variable in terms of the other.
Solve a pair of linear equations by making coefficients equal and eliminating a variable.
Use the ratios a1/a2, b1/b2 and c1/c2 to decide whether a pair has a unique, no or infinitely many solutions.

topics.title: Graphical method for solving a pair of linear equations

concepts.learning_objective: Find the solution of a pair of equations as the point common to both lines.
Relate intersecting, parallel and coincident lines to unique, no and infinitely many solutions.
